sec.title: August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 118)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American network, Morey Amsterdam reminiscing on his vaudeville and comedy writing career with Chuck Schaden, *Your Hit Parade* counting down 1937 chart-toppers for Lucky Strike, George Olsen & Ethel Shutta spoofing matrimonial agencies on the *Kraft Salad Bowl Revue*, and three deeply moving personal philosophy essays on Edward R. Murrow's *This I Believe* from Ruth Cranston, violinist Alexander Bloch, and theater director Harold Clurman (1933–1977):
